name: Energy Conduit (Gestalt)*
body:
You are a natural conduit for positive or negative energy.

Prerequisite: Wis 13, Cha 13, Divine Gift, character level 3rd.

Benefit: You can channel positive or negative energy like a cleric, using your character level – 2 as your effective cleric level when determining the amount of damage healed (or caused) and the DC; however, the channeling granted by this feat is less powerful — it has a 20-foot radius, and you roll d4s instead of d6s when determining the amount of damage healed (or caused). You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to your Charisma modifier.

Special: Just like a cleric, if you are a good character (or a neutral character who worships a good deity) you channel positive energy; if you are an evil character (or a neutral character who worships an evil deity) you channel negative energy. If you are a neutral character of a neutral deity (or one who is not devoted to a particular deity), you must choose whether you channel positive or negative energy when you take this feat. Once this choice is made, it cannot be reversed.
